description: Command patterns policy-engine.mjs (via lib/hooks.mjs) flags as destructive/irreversible per .claude/rules/git-safety.md and side-effects-recovery.md. A match requires a GRANTED approval-request (see authority.json 'destructive-git'/'destructive-data') before execution proceeds; hooks.mjs surfaces a warning, it does not silently block a real terminal (this pack has no shell hook execution authority over the host CLI) — it's consumed by review agents (git-auditor) and by ops.mjs effect logging to classify an effect automatically.
